Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: finished literary short-story cover, portrait 9:16, intended final size 864 x 1536 pixels.
Primary request: Paint the cover for "Knight Shift", a warm, quietly funny modern story about identical triplets sharing the face and online persona rgbknights while running a 24-hour bookshop/cafe. Show just one apparent manager; the three-in-one idea resides in the apron emblem.
Input images: Image 1 is the accepted character reference sheet: use Rafa (Raf) in the left column for face, dark curls cut close at the sides, long nose, ordinary modern black clothes and apron, red watch strap and small white tape at the edge of his left thumbnail. Image 2 is the accepted bookshop interior: use its wood, shelves, espresso counter, lamps, natural morning light and painterly surface as setting and visual guidance. Do not copy the sheet layout or any of its text.
Scene/backdrop: A lived-in modern independent bookshop and cafe at early morning, narrow shelves of varied used books and an espresso machine behind the counter. A pot of tea, an open paperback and a worn blue-jacketed paperback can occupy the counter. The room feels quietly occupied by conversations, without adding any other person.
Subject: The one apparent adult manager, Rafa, behind the counter, pausing over a paperback with an amused, attentive expression, as if listening to a customer's objection. Keep his identity recognizably the same as the reference. His black apron has the white knight's helmet with slightly offset RED, GREEN and BLUE helmet outlines from the sheet. The outlines are one modest printed emblem, not literal armor, glowing lights or separated knight figures.
Style/medium: Canadian Group of Seven inspired oil illustration. Broad rhythmic shapes, varied directional opaque strokes, quieter connecting passages, selective impasto, simplified figure and architecture, connected deep shadows and a few lost edges. Naturalistic human proportions. No glossy skin, uniform bevelled brushwork, theatrical rim light or automatic orange-blue contrast.
Composition/framing: True tall 9:16 cover composition. Upper quarter is quiet dark wall or shelves supporting clear title lettering; the figure and meaningful hands and emblem occupy the central and lower middle. Keep all essential title lettering, face, hands and emblem safely inside the central 80 percent of the width. Inviting, thoughtful, lightly comic literary mystery rather than epic fantasy.
Lighting/mood: Early daylight gently mixing with the cafe's practical lamps. Ordinary intimacy and the possibility that a familiar face contains a surprise.
Text (verbatim): "Knight Shift". Render this exact title ONCE, large, beautifully legible cream serif lettering in the upper quarter, optionally on two lines. No author name, subtitle, additional readable signage, watermark or repeated title.
Constraints: One human figure only. Reference-consistent face, black apron and helmet emblem. Ordinary modern cafe. Tiny white thumbnail tape is clean and bloodless. Accurate hands and ordinary book proportions. Preserve readable title in the final portrait crop. Opaque painted background.
